<reason>CON won by keeping the live question on the instrument, not the existence of risk. PRO had a real case on employer-mismatch and socialized catastrophe, but never showed a need-blind, take-home-first floor beats the status quo once incidence, dual coverage, and liquidity lock-in were on the table. CON answered the leverage trap cleanly, then used PRO's invoice “yes” to collapse the app-hole story into a levy on independent income. PRO's closing overclaimed a concession CON never made.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B4 after A4.3: restricted accounts still lock Friday cash, and owing the same contribution on a direct invoice turns the “platform repair” into a tax on the alternative.</best_rebuttal>
